title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Job Location\- Jaipur**

**Salary\-30000\- 40000 per month**

**Benefit\- Stay\+Food**

**Working Day\- Mon\-Fri**

**Immediate Joiner**

**Company Description** Technoledge™ is an education management and consulting partner that helps universities, colleges, schools, and skill institutions build future\-ready academic ecosystems. The organization focuses on integrating academic excellence, digital transformation, industry collaboration, research, innovation, and student development into a unified, sustainable framework. Its flagship expertise is in establishing Industry\-Driven Centres of Excellence (CoEs) with advanced labs, emerging technologies, certifications, and hands\-on learning across domains such as AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, Robotics, IoT, and Cloud Computing. Technoledge™ also provides integrated solutions including AI\-powered digital ERP, academic excellence programs, innovation and incubation support, research and patent guidance, industry partnerships, and international collaborations. The company is dedicated to building connected academic ecosystems that help institutions innovate, excel, and prepare learners for future careers.

**Role Description** The Data Science Trainer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida. The trainer will design and deliver data science curricula, including foundational concepts, statistical methods, machine learning techniques, and practical applications using relevant tools and programming languages. Daily responsibilities include preparing lesson plans, creating teaching materials, conducting interactive classroom sessions and labs, assessing learner performance, and providing feedback and mentoring. The Trainer will collaborate with academic and industry partners to align course content with current trends, support project\-based learning, and contribute to the development of Centres of Excellence in data science and related technologies. The role also involves updating training content regularly, participating in faculty development initiatives, and ensuring a high\-quality learning experience for diverse groups of learners.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Science Education with the ability to connect data science concepts to real\-world scientific and technological applications.
* Solid understanding of Mathematics, including statistics, probability, linear algebra, and calculus relevant to data science.
* Background in Physics or related quantitative disciplines that supports analytical thinking and problem\-solving in technical training environments.
* Experience as a Qualified Teacher or Trainer, with demonstrated skills in Lesson Planning, classroom delivery, and learner assessment.
* Proficiency in data science tools and languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and familiarity with machine learning libraries and visualization tools.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly, adapt teaching methods for varied learner profiles, and manage interactive, hands\-on sessions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with academic teams, industry partners, and institutional stakeholders.
* Experience developing curricula or training programs for higher education or skill development institutions is an advantage.

**Job Location\- Jaipur**

**Salary\- 30000\-40000 per month**

**Benefit\- Stay\+Food**

**Working Day\- Mon\-Sat**

**Immediate Joiner**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Data science: 3 years (Required)

Location:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Preferred)

title: Assistant Professor - Data Science & AI
description:
About us

AAFT has been providing education in media and arts for the past 30 years. We offer

50 \+ professional courses in various fields of Cinema, Journalism and Mass Communication, Performing Arts, Animation, Hospitality and Tourism, Still Photography, Advertising, PR and Events and Fashion Design.

We go beyond the traditional teaching method and focus more on the

Self\- discovery of students’ potential. AAFT boasts of rich cultural engagement and academic excellence. The Institute attracts students from some of the most popular countries in Asia, Africa, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America.

Company Website: https://www.aaft.com

**Designation: Assistant Professor \- Data Science \& AI (SODSAI**

**Location: Noida, Sector 16**

**Work Mode: 6 Days WFO**

**Shift Timings: 8:30 am \- 4:30 pm**

**Position Summary**

The Assistant Professor – Data Science \& AI will be responsible for delivering theoretical and practical training in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI, and Computer Vision. The role includes curriculum development, hands\-on project guidance, student mentoring, and keeping students aligned with emerging AI technologies and industry practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 Design and deliver AI training sessions covering:

 Python, SQL, Statistics, Advance Excel, Power BI,Tableau

 Machine Learning (Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement Learning)

 Deep Learning (CNNs, RNNs, GANs, LSTMs)

 Natural Language Processing (Transformer, BERT, Encoder\-Decoder, Sequence to Sequence Models)

 Generative AI (LLMs, Transformers, Prompt Engineering)

 Computer Vision

**Requirements:**

 Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.

 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML model development and deployment.

 Strong knowledge of Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras,Scikit\-learn, and ML libraries.

 Familiarity with Generative AI models (ChatGPT, LLaMA, DALL·E, etc.)

 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 Prior experience in teaching/training (corporate, academic, or bootcamp) is preferred.

 Excellent communication and presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

 Certifications in AI/ML from reputed organizations (e.g., Google, Coursera, Microsoft, DataCamp).

 Experience with MLOps, vector databases, and deployment tools.

 Agentic AI, Responsible AI, Explainable AI skills

 Knowledge of tools like Jupyter, GitHub, Docker, and VSCode.

 Contribution to AI open\-source projects or publications.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Current in hand salary?
* Expected in hand salary?
* Notice Period?
* How many years of experience do you have with AI/ML model development and deployment?

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Senior Technical Lead
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


esponsibilities
  

* Develop machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI models to support RCM use cases such as claim outcome prediction, denials classification, next best action recommendation, clinical appeal summarization, and workflow optimization.
* Build end to end ML pipelines including feature engineering, model training, hyperparameter tuning, validation, and monitoring.
* Research and apply advanced techniques in LLMs, embeddings, retrieval augmentation (RAG), prompt engineering, and document intelligence.
* Translate operational and product requirements into measurable model objectives, data specifications, and evaluation frameworks.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to understand data patterns, anomalies, and business insights.
* Implement and follow best practices around MLOps, including model versioning, reproducibility, feature stores, and drift monitoring.
* Partner with Data Engineers to ensure feature availability, data quality, and scalable ML/AI deployment within Azure Databricks and enterprise platforms.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to communicate insights, present model results, and drive adoption of ML solutions.
* Maintain awareness of emerging AI technologies and propose enhancements or new opportunities for Provider Engineering platforms.

  

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* 3–7\+ years of hands\-on experience developing ML or AI models in an applied industry setting (healthcare experience strongly preferred).
* Strong proficiency in:
* Databricks
* Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, NumPy, TensorFlow, MLflow)
* SQL
* Preferred: Knowledge of US healthcare, ideally with Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) experience, including familiarity with EDI transactions such as 837 and 835\.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment with rapid prototyping, ambiguity, and iterative delivery.
* Required: Strong working knowledge of GitHub Copilot (or equivalent enterprise\-approved AI coding assistant) to accelerate development.
* Self\-motivated and solution\-oriented; able to independently research, troubleshoot, and identify paths forward when facing technical or data challenges.
* Experience working in Azure or similar cloud environments:
* Azure Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake)
* Azure Machine Learning
* Azure Data Lake / Azure Data Factory (in partnership with Data Engineering)
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following:
* Classification, regression, time series, or recommendation systems
* Agentic AI / Large Language Models (LLMs) / RAG
* Strong statistical modeling foundation and experience building production\-quality ML systems.
* Ability to communicate technical findings to nontechnical stakeholders clearly and effectively.
